messages.subject: Zagrebacka banka | Director-Level Corporate Affairs, ESG & Regulatory Executive
messages.body:
Dear Zagrebacka banka Talent Acquisition Team,

I am submitting my executive profile for inclusion in your candidate database and consideration for senior opportunities across Zagrebacka banka and relevant UniCredit Group functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This background gives me a strong perspective on institutional trust, governance, regulatory engagement, sustainability and executive-level stakeholder management.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and related leadership functions. I am internationally mobile and open to Croatia, Central and Eastern Europe and broader UniCredit Group opportunities with employer-supported work authorization where required.

I have attached a Zagrebacka banka-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or future mandates and referral within the Group where appropriate.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
